column.name: description
column.value: Kiva posting attempts with status, user-friendly message and raw error, filterable by status, office, disbursed date and posting date

insert.column: SELECT kpl.id AS `ID`, COALESCE(c.display_name, kpl.client_name) AS `Client Name`, c.external_id AS `Client UID`, kpl.loan_account_no AS `Loan Account`, l.currency_code AS `Currency`, CASE WHEN kpl.has_passed = 1 THEN 'Posted' ELSE 'Not Posted' END AS `Posted / Not Posted`, CASE WHEN kpl.has_passed = 1 THEN 'Posted successfully' WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'MISSING_PROFILE_IMAGE' THEN 'Profile image is missing' WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE_IMAGE_TYPE' THEN 'Client profile image type is not supported by Kiva' WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'MISSING_DESCRIPTION' THEN 'Loan description for Kiva is missing' WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'MISSING_RECRUITMENT_SURVEY' THEN 'Client recruitment survey is missing' WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'UNSUPPORTED_LOCATION' THEN 'Client location is not supported by Kiva' WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'MISSING_KIVA_BUSINESS_DETAILS' THEN 'Kiva Business Details are missing' WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'MISSING_LOAN_USE' THEN 'Loan use is missing' WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'UNSUPPORTED_SECTOR_ACTIVITY' THEN 'Sector and activity are not supported by Kiva' WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY' THEN 'Loan currency is not supported by Kiva' WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'UNSUPPORTED_THEME' THEN 'Loan department is not supported by Kiva' WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'MULTIPLE_DATA_INTEGRITY_ISSUES' THEN CONCAT('Several data issues: ', CONCAT_WS(', ', CASE WHEN kpl.error_logs LIKE '%MISSING_PROFILE_IMAGE:%' THEN 'profile image' END, CASE WHEN kpl.error_logs LIKE '%UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE_IMAGE_TYPE:%' THEN 'profile image type' END, CASE WHEN kpl.error_logs LIKE '%MISSING_DESCRIPTION:%' THEN 'description' END, CASE WHEN kpl.error_logs LIKE '%MISSING_RECRUITMENT_SURVEY:%' THEN 'recruitment survey' END, CASE WHEN kpl.error_logs LIKE '%UNSUPPORTED_LOCATION:%' THEN 'location' END, CASE WHEN kpl.error_logs LIKE '%MISSING_KIVA_BUSINESS_DETAILS:%' THEN 'Kiva Business Details' END, CASE WHEN kpl.error_logs LIKE '%MISSING_LOAN_USE:%' THEN 'loan use' END, CASE WHEN kpl.error_logs LIKE '%UNSUPPORTED_SECTOR_ACTIVITY:%' THEN 'sector/activity' END, CASE WHEN kpl.error_logs LIKE '%UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY:%' THEN 'currency' END, CASE WHEN kpl.error_logs LIKE '%UNSUPPORTED_THEME:%' THEN 'department' END)) WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'KIVA_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED' THEN 'Could not log in to Kiva' WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'KIVA_SYSTEM_ERROR' THEN 'Could not reach Kiva (network or timeout)' WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'UNEXPECTED_ERROR' THEN 'Unexpected system error, contact IT' WHEN kpl.failure_category = 'KIVA_REJECTION' THEN CONCAT('Rejected by Kiva', COALESCE(CONCAT(': ', LEFT(CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(kpl.error_logs) THEN COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(kpl.error_logs, '$.message')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(kpl.error_logs, '$.errors[0].message')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(kpl.error_logs, '$.error_description')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(kpl.error_logs, '$.error'))) END, 200)), '')) ELSE 'Posting to Kiva failed' END AS `Message`, CASE WHEN kpl.has_passed = 1 THEN NULL ELSE LEFT(kpl.error_logs, 32000) END AS `Raw Error Message`, l.disbursedon_date AS `Disbursed Date`, DATE_FORMAT(kpl.created_on_utc, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS `Posting to Kiva Date (UTC)`, o.name AS `Office`, CASE WHEN kpl.trigger_type = 'application' AND tu.id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(tu.username, ' (manual run)') WHEN kpl.trigger_type = 'application' THEN 'Manual run' WHEN kpl.trigger_type = 'cron' THEN 'System (scheduled)' ELSE 'System' END AS `Triggered By`, kpl.failure_stage AS `Failure Stage`, kpl.failure_category AS `Failure Category`, kpl.batch_id AS `Batch ID`, kpl.loan_id AS `Loan ID` FROM m_kiva_posting_logger kpl LEFT JOIN m_loan l ON l.id = kpl.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_client c ON c.id = kpl.client_id LEFT JOIN m_office o ON o.id = COALESCE(l.office_id, c.office_id) LEFT JOIN m_appuser tu ON tu.id = kpl.triggered_by_user_id WHERE o.hierarchy like concat('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') AND ('${status}' = 'all' OR ('${status}' = 'posted' AND kpl.has_passed = 1) OR ('${status}' = 'notposted' AND kpl.has_passed = 0)) AND ('${officeIds}' = 'all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_office so WHERE POSITION(CONCAT('-', so.id, '-') IN '${officeIds}') > 0 AND o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(so.hierarchy, '%'))) AND ('${disbursedFrom}' = '' OR l.disbursedon_date >= NULLIF('${disbursedFrom}', '')) AND ('${disbursedTo}' = '' OR l.disbursedon_date <= NULLIF('${disbursedTo}', '')) AND ('${postedFrom}' = '' OR kpl.date >= NULLIF('${postedFrom}', '')) AND ('${postedTo}' = '' OR kpl.date <= NULLIF('${postedTo}', '')) ORDER BY CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'client' AND '${sortOrder}' = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(c.display_name, kpl.client_name) END ASC, CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'client' AND '${sortOrder}' <> 'asc' THEN COALESCE(c.display_name, kpl.client_name) END DESC, CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'account' AND '${sortOrder}' = 'asc' THEN kpl.loan_account_no END ASC, CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'account' AND '${sortOrder}' <> 'asc' THEN kpl.loan_account_no END DESC, CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'currency' AND '${sortOrder}' = 'asc' THEN l.currency_code END ASC, CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'currency' AND '${sortOrder}' <> 'asc' THEN l.currency_code END DESC, CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'status' AND '${sortOrder}' = 'asc' THEN kpl.has_passed END ASC, CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'status' AND '${sortOrder}' <> 'asc' THEN kpl.has_passed END DESC, CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'disbursed' AND '${sortOrder}' = 'asc' THEN l.disbursedon_date END ASC, CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'disbursed' AND '${sortOrder}' <> 'asc' THEN l.disbursedon_date END DESC, CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'posted' AND '${sortOrder}' = 'asc' THEN kpl.created_on_utc END ASC, CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'posted' AND '${sortOrder}' <> 'asc' THEN kpl.created_on_utc END DESC, CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'office' AND '${sortOrder}' = 'asc' THEN o.name END ASC, CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'office' AND '${sortOrder}' <> 'asc' THEN o.name END DESC, CASE WHEN '${orderBy}' = 'id' AND '${sortOrder}' = 'asc' THEN kpl.id END ASC, kpl.id DESC LIMIT ${limit} OFFSET ${offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m_kiva_posting_logger kpl LEFT JOIN m_loan l ON l.id = kpl.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_client c ON c.id = kpl.client_id LEFT JOIN m_office o ON o.id = COALESCE(l.office_id, c.office_id) WHERE o.hierarchy like concat('${currentUserHierarchy}', '%') AND ('${status}' = 'all' OR ('${status}' = 'posted' AND kpl.has_passed = 1) OR ('${status}' = 'notposted' AND kpl.has_passed = 0)) AND ('${officeIds}' = 'all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_office so WHERE POSITION(CONCAT('-', so.id, '-') IN '${officeIds}') > 0 AND o.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(so.hierarchy, '%'))) AND ('${disbursedFrom}' = '' OR l.disbursedon_date >= NULLIF('${disbursedFrom}', '')) AND ('${disbursedTo}' = '' OR l.disbursedon_date <= NULLIF('${disbursedTo}', '')) AND ('${postedFrom}' = '' OR kpl.date >= NULLIF('${postedFrom}', '')) AND ('${postedTo}' = '' OR kpl.date <= NULLIF('${postedTo}', ''))
